title: Import from Excel with a full preview, duplicate detection and undo
changes: Data menu → Import from Excel (.xlsx); the file is read in the browser with no libraries and nothing is uploaded

Sheets are recognised by their headers: trade log (WallStreet layout, including the older layout with a currency column), deposits and withdrawals, daily account value, and the holdings snapshot (prices and the dollar rate)

Trade blocks: symbol and action type carry down to the rows below; ticker taken from names such as 'ACME CORP (ACME)' or 'GAMA US'; summary and label rows skipped; dates read both as Excel dates and as dd/mm/yyyy text
Preview per sheet: new / existing / conflict / error for every row, with the reason, and a note explaining where the sheet's own totals differ (fee left out of the total, reversed sign)
Each sheet can be excluded; sales are re-checked against what would be held
Re-importing the same file adds nothing: every row has an import key; an identical manually typed action is also recognised
The equity sheet's deposit column is not imported, so deposits are never counted twice; a date repeated with the same value is imported once
Prices from the sheet never replace a price already on the site and are labelled 'from Excel'
One confirmed write: the previous data is kept in the browser and the import can be undone from the notification
